step_a: Trace each original marker along NW-SE to its two in-bounds boundary endpoints, and paint the main-ray grid.
intermediate: The input-dependent list of boundary endpoints together with the painted main-ray grid.
step_b: Paint anti-diagonal continuations exactly once from those frozen endpoints onto the main-ray grid.
why_b_depends_on_a: Continuation origins depend on each marker's position and the canvas boundary. Substituting the original marker positions for A's endpoints, while retaining A's painted grid, changes the final answer. This establishes a derived geometric dependency, not iterative simulation.

(rule! (lambda (g)
      (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
             (sources (filter (lambda (p) (not (zero? (at g (fst p) (snd p)))))
                              (grid-positions g)))
             (ends sources)
             (stage-a ((lambda (g)
         (reduce (lambda (acc pos)
                   (let* ((r (fst pos))
                          (c (snd pos))
                          (v (at g r c)))
                     (if (zero? v)
                         acc
                         (reduce (lambda (g2 dir)
                                   (let ((dr (fst dir))
                                         (dc (snd dir)))
                                     (reduce (lambda (g3 d)
                                               (let ((nr (+ r (* dr d)))
                                                     (nc (+ c (* dc d))))
                                                 (if (and
                                                       (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                                       (zero? (at g nr nc))
                                                       (zero? (at g3 nr nc)))
                                                     (set-cell g3 nr nc v)
                                                     g3)))
                                             g2
                                             (range 1 (max h w)))))
                                 acc
                                 '((-1 -1) (1 1))))))
                 g
                 (grid-positions g))) g))
             (color (at g (fst (first sources)) (snd (first sources)))))
        (reduce
          (lambda (acc pos)
            (reduce
              (lambda (g2 dir)
                (reduce
                  (lambda (g3 d)
                    (let ((nr (+ (fst pos) (* (fst dir) d)))
                          (nc (+ (snd pos) (* (snd dir) d))))
                      (if (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (zero? (at g3 nr nc)))
                          (set-cell g3 nr nc color) g3)))
                  g2 (range 1 (max h w))))
              acc '((-1 1) (1 -1))))
          stage-a ends))))
